When policy feels predictable, but the path still tilts higher for longer, mispricing can creep in and chances appear quickly. Cloudflare (NET)

Cloudflare fits directly into this large-cap U.S. growth and technology theme as a cloud and edge security platform that helps enterprises keep websites, apps, and networks fast and protected in an environment where long-term rates can quickly reprice high-multiple software stocks.

Cloudflare offers a broad suite of internet security, performance, and developer tools for businesses, with all of its roughly US$2.5b in revenue coming from cloud-based Internet Telephone services, and the stock valued by the market at around US$116b today.

What happened?

A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after cybersecurity stocks surged as investors reacted to a massive new wave of artificial intelligence-enabled cyber threats that industry experts have dubbed "Black October."

As reported by CNBC, U.S. security agencies including the National Security Agency and FBI issued urgent warnings regarding critical vulnerabilities in PHP, the core programming language used to build nearly 70% of the internet. Cybersecurity teams globally are now in a frantic scramble to patch these security flaws, which were discovered utilizing advanced AI models, CNBC explained. CNBC noted that the extreme urgency of the situation was underscored by industry executives who stated that the last two days alone have seen dozens of cyberattacks that individually would normally represent the worst breach of an entire calendar year. In response to these unprecedented threats, federal agencies have recommended that organizations make immediate fixes to their code or take vulnerable legacy systems completely offline, according to CNBC.

Consequently, CNBC reported that Wall Street analysts view this rapidly evolving threat landscape as a massive long-term catalyst for the sector, with experts highlighting that cybersecurity platform providers will be the clear beneficiaries of continued AI development. As a result, shares across the identity management and network security space rallied sharply as organizations rushed to upgrade their defensive postures against these AI-driven exploits, CNBC concluded.

The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.

ARK Pares GOOG, PLTR, CRWD Stakes

Ark Invest reduced its exposure to several widely followed technology stocks during the session.

In the ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK), the firm sold 15,302 shares of Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR). It also sold 17,740 shares of Shopify Inc. (SHOP), 65,812 shares of Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) and 9,215 shares of Cloudflare Inc. (NET).

ARK had pared its stakes in Alphabet and Shopify last week as well. Alphabet and Cloudflare also appeared among the sales in the ARK Next Generation Technology ETF (ARKW). ARKW sold 11,355 shares of Alphabet and 2,786 shares of Cloudflare.

ARKW also sold 9,240 shares of Palantir, along with shares of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. (CRWD), Circle Internet Group Inc. (CRCL), Roblox Corp. (RBLX), Rubrik Inc. (RBRK), Block Inc. (XYZ) and Everpure Inc. (P).

The ARKW trades included the sale of 42,499 shares of Circle and 34,222 shares of Roblox.

ARKG Continues To Load Up On Biotech Stocks

The buying activity was concentrated in the ARK Genomic Revolution ETF (ARKG), where Ark added positions across a group of biotechnology companies rather than concentrating its purchases in a single stock.

ARKG bought 68,266 shares of Pacific Biosciences of California Inc. (PACB), 22,479 shares of Scribe Therapeutics Inc. (SCTX) and 169,498 shares of Freenome Inc. (FRNM).

Pacific Biosciences was also added to the ARK Innovation ETF.

Across the two funds, Ark therefore bought Pacific Biosciences in both ARKG and ARKK, while the ARKG purchases also included Scribe Therapeutics and Freenome.

ARKG's price closed up by nearly 1% in Friday's regular trading session and rose nearly 0.2% during the after-hours trade. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits around ARKG trended in the 'neutral' territory at the time of writing.

Key Takeaways

Palo Alto Networks rose 6.5% today, CrowdStrike rose 6.7%, Okta rose 5%, Cloudflare rose 6% and Zscaler rose 4%, after an Evercore ISI survey of cybersecurity channel partners found security budgets getting stronger.

The rally started Wednesday, when the PHP Foundation disclosed critical flaws found with AI's help and Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora warned more are coming.

Analysts expect Palo Alto's revenue to grow 23% in the fiscal year ending July 2027, but its normalized EPS to grow only 9% as its share count rises.

Palo Alto traded at 85x forward earnings before today's move, with estimates already at the top of guidance, so its next report has to show the spending.

Palo Alto Networks (PANW:NASDAQ) stock is up 6.5% today, and the cybersecurity group is up with it: CrowdStrike (CRWD:NASDAQ) is up 6.7%, Okta (OKTA:NASDAQ) 5%, Cloudflare (NET:NYSE) 6% and Zscaler (ZS:NASDAQ) 4%.

The trigger: a reseller survey showing security budgets getting stronger into year-end, in a week already dominated by a security scare.

Resellers are seeing the spending

Security stocks started rallying on Wednesday after the PHP Foundation disclosed critical flaws, found with AI's help, in code much of the web runs on. That afternoon, Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora told the TBPN podcast: "We're gonna see more of these, not less."

This morning, Evercore ISI's quarterly survey of cybersecurity channel partners added a demand read on top of that. Partners resell and install the products, so they see purchases first. They described:

Budgets getting stronger into year-end

Healthy pipelines, with no sign of demand dropping off

Spending on securing data and AI, identities and cloud environments

Okta had the strongest pipeline momentum of any vendor surveyed, and Evercore named it one of two stocks to highlight.

Meta Platforms

Meta fell 7% on Thursday and is down 9.1% over the week after Wednesday's post-close results, with a surprise plan to issue a new class of non-voting stock overshadowing stronger-than-expected third-quarter revenue.

The company's special committee said in its filing that the move was motivated not only by keeping CEO Mark Zuckerberg in California but also by "an increasingly challenging environment for raising capital," citing recent and anticipated raises at Alphabet, SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI to fund the same AI growth.

Trading disclosure

Cloudflare's stock has surged over the past few years as investors have latched onto its role in web security and edge computing. With the shares now around US$303.61, the open question is whether that price tag is still supported by its sales base.

Cloudflare has delivered a very large 3 year share price gain of about 4.5x, which makes the gap between its long term share performance and its underlying revenue scale an important issue to examine.

The company's rapid response to the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities and ongoing work to support AI driven internet traffic can influence how investors think about future top line potential relative to current P/S levels.

The analysts covering Cloudflare have run their own numbers. See what analysts think Cloudflare's shares could be worth.

The issue now is whether Cloudflare's recent share price, after that strong multi year run and a busy stretch of security and AI related announcements, is justified by its sales when compared with the Fair Ratio benchmark.

If you want to test the same sales based valuation question across more AI focused infrastructure players, line Cloudflare up against the 55 AI infrastructure stocks.

Does Cloudflare Look Pricey on Sales?

The P/S lens fits Cloudflare because sales, not earnings, are the cleaner anchor for a business still reinvesting heavily. On this yardstick, the stock trades on a P/S of 43.0x, which is far above both the IT sector average of 2.0x and the 13.8x peer group level for similar infrastructure and security players. A tailored Fair Ratio that blends Cloudflare's growth profile, margin structure, size and risk highlights this as a rich valuation, with the current multiple sitting meaningfully above that benchmark. In other words, the market is already paying a steep price for its revenue base.

The PHP2Shell response and the positive reaction it triggered help explain why investors are willing to ascribe such a premium to Cloudflare's security and AI traffic franchise. Even so, the gap to sector and peer norms still leaves little room for missteps on execution or demand. For anyone weighing the stock today, the key question is whether that 43.0x P/S can be supported by future sales quality and durability, or whether expectations have run too far ahead of the underlying revenue scale.
